identity.bot: Exact existing complete Matrix ID; no shadow account, renamed Bot or duplicate DS-Bot
identity.owner: Existing exact ownerId, validated through home accounts; remote administrator/member never becomes owner
identity.node: Existing node credential scoped to the original Bot, original private node directory, home Core/homeserver only

directory.auth: Bot-scoped node credential; legacy deployment node secret remains compatible but never an ordinary home session
directory.scope: Only actual joined members of this exact room who are active local participants or explicitly admitted external identities; bot must actually be joined. No full admission list, credentials or private Bot instructions.

ownerGrants.auth: Active home human token and exact existing bot.ownerId
ownerGrants.semantics: Default foreign work denied. CAS owner grants are distinct from administrator governance.botPolicies. Server governance is an additional ceiling.

roomWorkPolicy.publisherValidation: Read actual current Matrix state event and power_levels at the home homeserver. Require exact issuerId=sender=@dscord-control:<registered authority>, current membership, event type/key/room binding, and actual power >= max(state_default or event-specific level, 50). Pin event ID/revision/hash; never trust user-supplied owner/authority metadata.
roomWorkPolicy.federationHandoff: Use existing org.dscord.work_policy, with existing authority/revision/enabled/botIds/tools/memberIds plus schemaVersion:1 and exact roomId. Federation/admin line publishes this after successful room application using its already-powered authority control account; the Bot slice validates it.
roomWorkPolicy.localMembership: memberIds explicitly admits external identities; origin-authority local members use actual Matrix membership. Home Core still checks each foreign identity against its own explicit admission and exact owner grant requesterIds.

rechecks: attachment read even on cache hit

authorization.failClosed: Authorization or Matrix check failure prevents new effects. A relevant rule/version/participant change invalidates the admitted authorization; no automatic model replay.
authorization.audit: Persistent admission, decision and effect events in home bot-work.sqlite; native tool receipts, uploaded files, unknown sends and late results retain their original task/transaction relationships.

context.domain: Hash of exact Bot ID, authoritative collaboration server, full room ID and admission security binding
context.session: Persistent ordinary DSH native Session, distinct from original DS-Bot private owner Session; original identity and DS-Bot binding retained. No fork/copy of owner history or private memory.
context.history: Only exact target room events from currently admitted and actually joined members. Files enter only through verified current/referenced Matrix events. Explicitly shared content is copied as task input.
context.tools: File paths must resolve within the current task workspace, including symlink/ancestor validation. No terminal, jobs, skills, memory, session-reading or delegation tools in this first cross-server scope. Local existing paths retain their compatibility behavior.

media.identity: Full {roomId,eventId,senderId,attachmentId,contentUri,sha256,size}, resolved from the actual Matrix event at the home homeserver
media.download: Use original Bot home Matrix authenticated media download through the proven mxc URI; never resolve a foreign attachmentId through home Core media.get(id). Verify bytes and hash. Cache is scoped and authorization is rechecked before cache use.
media.output: Upload with original Bot token to its home Core; stable upload ID and Matrix transaction preserve retry identity; send descriptors in the original federated room and reply to the exact source event/full human ID.
media.handoff: Generic room-proven media UI APIs remain owned by federation line. This node uses Matrix room/event proof directly.
media.limits: Input byte ceiling is min(current home media limit, actual node maximum); policy hash includes this ceiling.

delivery.initialScope: Original approved room and exact original human; explicit same-room two-member direct conversation supported. Crossing to a new/unapproved DM or delegating externally is refused until separately supported.
delivery.revocation: Block further tools/upload/send, preserve already observed effects and unknown results, no compensation or retrospective success assertion.
